name: devflow
description: DevFlow – AI-powered bug tracking & test management platform (Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Playwright, k6)

scripts.setup: npm run db:setup && npm run build
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w apps/backend" "npm run start -w apps/frontend"
